summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running any repository code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple to the constructor; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal and returning True/False; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified: tests, mypy, and black were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed.
